description: FULL BODY (head to toe). A Malaysian man in his late 30s, athletic build, wearing a formal navy blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, epaulettes on the shoulders, and a service cap. He has short black hair, a neatly groomed mustache, and is wearing polished black leather boots.

FULL BODY (head to toe). A Malaysian woman in her late 60s, petite build, wearing a traditional green floral Baju Kurung with a matching cream-colored hijab. She is wearing simple leather sandals and has a gentle, grandmotherly appearance with subtle wrinkles around her eyes.

FULL BODY (head to toe). A featureless, anonymous human silhouette completely void of facial features. The figure is shrouded in a dark, semi-transparent digital glitch effect. To differentiate, the figure wears a dark hooded sweatshirt and has glowing blue circuit-like patterns pulsating faintly across the torso and limbs.
